metadata.title: UwU Underground as a spyware/APT lead index (not a source)
metadata.frame: uwu_underground names FinSpy, Pegasus, APT28, Charming Kitten, Stealth Falcon, DarkHotel, Phineas Fisher, uXDT, Apple Live Rewind. Treat posts as leads. Lyrics are party voice. Primaries: Citizen Lab, Kaspersky, DOJ, FTC, Apple privacy paper. Harm pipeline is graded inference, not a kill-list. Overlay.

edges.notes: 2015 ~400GB dump of Hacking Team (RCS/Galileo) client lists and source. Same handle as the 2014 Gamma/FinFisher op. Fact of disclosure (Citizen Lab HT block).
Kaspersky 2014: Darkhotel/Tapaoux hotel-WiFi watering-hole APT against diplomats/execs in Asia. UwU Vol 3 tribute is a lead, not a source (fact of the actor report).
Citizen Lab 2016 Stealth Falcon: UAE-nexus spearphish against journalists/activists. DarkMatter/Project Raven sits in the same neighborhood. Targeting = fact; named-prisoner join = graded inference.

Charming Kitten / Phosphorus / APT35 = IRGC-nexus (CISA/Microsoft). Documented targets include Masih Alinejad; Ruhollah Zam and Jamshid Sharmahd are Iran cross-border cases in the public record. Labor-camp/organ-harvest overlay from lyrics is not sourced here.

Watch Series 12 / Ultra 4 Audio Intelligence: rolling mic buffer in Secure Exclave; Live Rewind = last 15s as text on double-press Crown + chime. Apple: no accessible recording. All-party eavesdropping-law fight (CA/MA/PA/WA). Always-on buffer = fact; 'spyware' as FinSpy-class implant = advocacy.
